The Cryojunkie is a fairly standard crew member with the additional ability to revive as a cryohusk upon death. Besides this latent ability, they have no other objectives or special gear.
30 seconds after they die, they'll transform into a cryohusk accompanied by a large burst of cryogas (potentially creating even more cryohusks). After this, another death will be final and they will not revive again.
